name: warm-bathroom-lazy-selfie
image_purpose: bathroom lifestyle, pajamas, and warm mirror-light reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic waist-up bathroom mirror selfie of an approved adult woman during a cozy nighttime self-care moment.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with voluminous messy dark brunette hair, light blue eyes, natural makeup, glossy pink lips, and a cream opaque satin long-sleeve pajama set with secure coverage, holding a gray smartphone.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level 9:16 mirror selfie, marble counter with generic skincare bottles, three-bulb vanity fixture, dark wood cabinets, white towels, and accurate reflection. Do not reproduce product labels or private text.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm indoor vanity light, intimate but non-sexualized cozy nighttime bathroom atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic lifestyle mirror photography, portrait 9:16, waist-up, realistic reflections, soft background focus, natural skin texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with messy dark brunette hair takes a waist-up bathroom mirror selfie in an opaque cream satin long-sleeve pajama set, holding a gray smartphone. Show marble counter, generic skincare bottles, warm three-bulb vanity light, dark wood cabinets, white towels, accurate reflection, and a cozy nighttime self-care mood. No private labels or watermark.
